title: RulePrintDocument
description: A ruleprint.json document: the book of business rules generated for one commit of a project.

specVersion.description: Version of this specification the document conforms to.

generatedAt.description: When the document was generated (RFC 3339 date-time).

rules.description: All rules known for this commit. Rule ids must be unique within the document.

name.description: Human-readable project name, usually the repository or package name.

commit.description: Git commit the document was generated from (7 to 40 hex chars).

repository.description: Web URL of the repository, used to link sources to files and lines (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo).

RuleId.title: RuleId
RuleId.description: Stable rule identifier: RP- followed by at least four digits.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: How much a rule can be trusted: declared by a human, derived from a test, or inferred from code.

RuleStatus.title: RuleStatus
RuleStatus.description: Review status of the rule relative to ruleprint.lock.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: Outcome of the last known execution of the tests backing a rule.

SourceKind.title: SourceKind
SourceKind.description: What kind of artifact a source location points at.

Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
Fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the normalised AST of the rule's origin, prefixed with the algorithm.

RuleSource.title: RuleSource
RuleSource.description: A location in the repository that contributes to a rule.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes.

symbol.description: Function, class or test name at the location, when known.

RuleOrigin.title: RuleOrigin
RuleOrigin.description: Where the rule came from and how much it can be trusted.

collector.description: Name of the collector that produced the rule (built-ins: tests, config, annotations, ast).

tests.description: Full names of the tests that exercise the rule.

coveredLines.description: Number of source lines covered by the tests listed above.

title.description: One-line statement of the rule in business language.

approvedAt.description: When the current fingerprint was approved (RFC 3339 date-time).

approvedBy.description: Who approved it, as '<provider>:<identity>', e.g. git:maria@empresa.com.
